Leaving the 450 Metres was bumped on a number of occasions by SUPER DRAGON which shifted out, resulting in TURIN CHAMPIONS becoming unbalanced and shifting in.  H Bowman pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 200 Metres (see SUPER DRAGON).  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 750 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by TURIN CHAMPIONS which shifted in when racing greenly before being corrected by its rider H Bowman.  H Bowman was reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to straighten his mounts sooner than what he did on this occasion.  Leaving the 450 Metres endeavoured to shift out to obtain clear running to the outside of CROSSBORDERDUDE and as a result made contact with TURIN CHAMPIONS on a number of occasions.  When SUPER DRAGON was prevented from shifting out by TURIN CHAMPIONS, SUPER DRAGON then was checked when disappointed for clear running.  Z Purton, rider of SUPER DRAGON, was advised to exercise more care.  H Bowman (TURIN CHAMPIONS) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 200 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of SUPER DRAGON, resulting in SUPER DRAGON having to be checked when it lost its running to the inside of TURIN CHAMPIONS.  H Bowman was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 18 January 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.

Near the 1000 Metres SKY CAP hung in and away from CLOUD NINE (L Ferraris) when that runner shifted in when not clear.  As a consequence SKY CAP made contact with PACKING PHOENIX, resulting in PACKING PHOENIX shifting in and bumping heavily with LEADING AGILITY, causing LEADING AGILITY to become unbalanced.  L Ferraris was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is two lengths clear when shifting ground.

Near the 1000 Metres was bumped by SKY CAP and became unbalanced.  Bumped near the 150 Metres.  When questioned Z Purton stated that after obtaining a trailing position behind the leaders he shifted his mount out near the 600 Metres to commence a forward move when it made contact with EMBRACE ABERDEEN.  He said PACKING PHOENIX failed to respond to his riding thereafter and finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  He added that whilst PACKING PHOENIX was held up at its previous race start in the early stages of the Home Straight, when asked for an effort thereafter, it also finished the race off only fairly on that occasion.  He said at its most recent starts and in track work the horse made a respiratory noise when under pressure.  Trainer K W Lui stated that the horse had pleased him leading into today’s race and an endoscopic examination performed on the horse did not reveal any abnormality.  He added that he could offer no explanation for PACKING PHOENIX failing to run on in the Home Straight today but would now consider dropping the horse back in distance to 1000 Metres for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PACKING PHOENIX was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, PACKING PHOENIX will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   Sent for sampling post-race.

He said as a consequence EMBRACE ABERDEEN found it difficult to finish the race off strongly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.incident_text: Shortly after the start made heavy contact with PERFECT TEAM when crowded by MASK RIDER which shifted out abruptly when being corrected by its rider M Chadwick.  As a consequence TALENTS TRUMP blundered.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <29/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Reports> After the race, TALENTS TRUMP was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. TALENTS TRUMP was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer F C Lor yesterday morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to have sustained a right front tendon injury. Before being allowed to race again, TALENTS TRUMP will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
M Chadwick reported that the instructions were to hold an on-pace position but when his mount shifted out at the start it settled further back in the field than intended.
